# observe_inbound_share_setup (Data Source)

Returns the Observe consumer Snowflake account to grant an inbound share to, and the SQL to run in the provider account to share data with Observe.

-> **Preview:** Inbound shares are in private preview and must be enabled for your tenant. The schema may change.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "observe_inbound_share_setup" "setup" {}

output "observe_consumer_account" {
  description = "Observe's Snowflake consumer account, to add as a recipient of the share."
  value       = data.observe_inbound_share_setup.setup.consumer_account
}

output "setup_sql" {
  description = "SQL to run in the provider account, for shares not managed by Terraform."
  value       = [for step in data.observe_inbound_share_setup.setup.setup_sql : step.sql]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `cloud` (String) Cloud provider of the consumer account. Empty when it cannot be derived from the region.
- `consumer_account` (String) Observe's consumer Snowflake account, as `<ORG>.<ACCOUNT>`. Add it to the share's accounts.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `region` (String) Snowflake region of the consumer account. The share must be in the same region.
- `setup_sql` (List of Object) SQL to run in the provider account to share data with Observe. Statements may contain `<placeholders>` to fill in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--setup_sql))

<a id="nestedatt--setup_sql"></a>
### Nested Schema for `setup_sql`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `sql` (String)
